title: Refuse a brief or a new session for a roadmap step that another live session already carries
why: Coordinator 15:00 CST Nov 8, its own mistake: at 11:45 CST it routed step draft-pr-guard-heredoc to session_013NEJL43F31tNPDKT4u3HJv, while session_013NEJKzzx35nAWSwPacHRXt already ran that step and had handed #1820, #1863, #1897 and #1915. The duplicate is archived; branch archive/draft-pr-guard-heredoc-restart holds its work. Red case: a create_session or brief for a cs-step tag that a live session already carries is refused, naming that session.
note: Sighting (coordinator 15:42 CST Nov 8): it started lane session_013NEJL33qiuVEZBa4bipxtY for step review-state-guard-needs-round-3, whose PR #2252 already existed. The check should read a step's handed PR too, not only live sessions. Sighting (coordinator 18:49 CST Nov 8): two lanes on Nov 8 could not find triage through list_sessions, though get_session shows triage tagged cs-build:triage and cs-repo:shivinate7/claude-settings.
